# pangolin_resource (Data Source)

Look up an existing Pangolin resource by resource_id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pangolin_resource" "example" {
  resource_id = 5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `full_domain` (String)
- `mode` (String)
- `name` (String)
